lesson: [2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] On the JD visual-event ridge task, full stems added +0.0185 AP, CI [0.0150, 0.0219], over the mix bus AP of 0.1753 but missed the required +0.02; the neural stem arm's lift 2.99 versus the bus-only checkpoint's 3.17 and rhythm baseline's 1.48 also did not improve on what it replaced. G9.7-split failed: valid head/hand results did not establish the source-specific benefit, while the degenerate footfall R2 and its derived split aggregate are invalid submetrics, not physiological evidence. The recorded 90-song trailing-window/whole-track comparison completes the reporting component of G9.7-causal, not full live LIGHT qualification, and this scoped outcome is not a rejection of every stem method or corpus.
